column1: # Forms a derived abbreviation never takes (docs/schema-v2.md, „Short names“). A public timetable
# of a German university must not show KKK or SS next to a lecture, and a module must not read
# form    the form as it reads, 2 to 10 characters; it also blocks the form with a series number
#         or a language level (SS1, SS-A1). Compared without case.
# A derived candidate on this list is dropped, the way a candidate of the wrong length is, and
# the module falls back to its next one. The capitals of the buildings in short room names (ZHG,
# HG, LG, VG, ZB …) and the campus codes SFB and SD are blocked too, by code
# (normalize.BuildingTokens): a week grid shows a module and its room side by side. Two
# exceptions: a title that has the form as a word of its own („IBM Watson“, „NS-Zeit“) may use
# it, and a line of overrides.tsv may name a blocked form on purpose. validate fails when a
# derived abbreviation is on this list.

column2: Nazi organisation (Sicherheitsdienst); also the campus code of Sachsendorf
